مُزَاحِمٌ , (T, TA,) or أَبُو مُزَاحِمٍ, (T, K, TA,) or اِبْنُ مُزَاحِمٍ, (M, TA,) The elephant: (T, M, K:) and a bull having horns: so in the T, on the authority of IAar: (TA:) or a bull having the horns broken. (M, K, TA) ―
-b2- مُزَاحِمٌ is also the name of A certain horse. (K, * TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
